# POL-004 Compliance Manual

> Fictional document for demonstration. Not a real policy.

## 1. Purpose

Describes the compliance function at Acme, its responsibilities, and the process by which regulatory change is identified and absorbed into internal documents.

## 2. Definitions

- **Regulatory Publication**: a circular, notification, guideline, FAQ or order issued by SEBI, an exchange, a clearing corporation or a depository.
- **Affected Document**: any document in the policy repository whose clause is touched by a Regulatory Publication.
- **Review SLA**: the period within which an Affected Document must be reviewed.

## 3. Compliance function

### 3.1 Independence

The CCO reports to the Board and is not part of any revenue function.

### 3.2 Responsibilities

1. Maintain the policy repository as the single source of truth (README).
2. Monitor Regulatory Publications (§7).
3. File periodic reports (§5).
4. Coordinate inspections (§6).
5. Maintain the code of conduct (§8).

## 4. Record keeping

Records listed in the retention schedule (PRIV-001 §6) shall be retained for a minimum of 5 years or the period required by regulation, whichever is longer.

## 5. Periodic reporting

| Report | Frequency | Due |
|---|---|---|
| Client funds and securities balance | Weekly | Friday, 17:00 IST |
| Net worth certificate | Half-yearly | 30 days after period end |
| Internal audit report | Half-yearly | 60 days after period end |
| Compliance certificate to Board | Quarterly | Board meeting |

## 6. Inspections

Exchange and SEBI inspection requests shall be acknowledged within 1 working day and documents supplied within the period stated in the request.

## 7. Regulatory change management

### 7.1 Monitoring

The compliance team shall check SEBI and exchange publication feeds every trading day.

### 7.2 Impact assessment

For every new Regulatory Publication, compliance shall record within 5 working days whether it is applicable to Acme and which documents are affected.

### 7.3 Review SLA

Affected Documents shall be reviewed and, where required, amended within **30 calendar days** of the publication date, or by the effective date stated in the publication, whichever is earlier.

### 7.4 Record of reviews

Each review shall be recorded as a compliance review issue in the policy repository, citing the regulatory clause and the affected clause, and closed only after the amendment is merged or the publication is confirmed not applicable.

### 7.5 Interim measures

Where an amendment cannot be completed before the regulatory effective date, the CCO shall issue an interim instruction to the affected desk, which prevails over the existing document until the amendment is merged.

## 8. Code of conduct

Employees shall not front-run client orders, shall disclose personal trading accounts, and shall complete annual conduct training.

## 9. Review

Annual review by the Board.
